name: Business Dual Credit (Richmond SD38 with KPU Melville School of Business)
org: Richmond School District 38 and Kwantlen Polytechnic University
what_you_do: Take four business courses that transfer to a university. They are marketing, talking at work, how groups work, and accounting. You go full time at KPU Surrey in semester 2.
who_can_apply: Students registered in a Richmond SD38 school. English 12 and Math 11 at 67% or higher, strong attendance. Apply in grade 11 to take it in grade 12. Must be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident.
pay_detail: District pays tuition. Books, supplies and travel are the student's cost.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027-28 are open. Due Mar 9, 2027.
how_to_apply: Get the form on the district page or at the school Career Programs board. Send it to the Career Programs office in person or by email. You need 2 teacher references, a reference letter and a resume.
notes: The program page prints no due date or contact. The 2027-28 form it links gives Mar 9, 2027. Email careerprograms@sd38.bc.ca with questions.
